issue.title: Memory notes xprompts.md and glossary.md still document the removed %name/%n and %tribe/%t directives
issue.description:
Discovered on 2026-08-12 while planning a chop change that needed to name a launched agent from a prompt. The Directives table in sase/memory/xprompts.md lists '%name:<n>' (alias %n) as the agent-name directive and '%tribe:<name>' (alias %t) as the tribe directive, and the 'Agent Tribe' entry in sase/memory/glossary.md likewise says tribes are assigned with '%tribe:<name>' (alias %t). Both directives were removed from SASE and now fail closed.

ROOT CAUSE: src/sase/xprompt/_directive_types.py lists 'name' and 'tribe' in _DEPRECATED_DIRECTIVE_MESSAGES, and _DIRECTIVE_ALIASES still maps 'n' -> 'name' and 't' -> 'tribe', so the short spellings resolve to the deprecated canonical names. _directive_collect.py raises DirectiveError for any deprecated directive. The memory notes were never updated when the directives were retired.

REPRODUCTION (this workspace, master 56d6bd772):
  .venv/bin/python -c "from sase.xprompt._directive_extract import extract_prompt_directives as e; e('%n:foo.@ x', process_references=lambda s: s)"
    -> DirectiveError: The '%name'/'%n' directive has been renamed; use %id/%i, and %id(<id>, clan=<clan>) to join a clan.
  Same call with '%t:mytribe x'
    -> DirectiveError: The '%tribe'/'%t' directive has been removed; use %id(tribe=<tribe>) or the #tribe xprompt for an auto-named agent, %id(<id>, tribe=<tribe>) for an explicitly named agent, or %clan(<clan>, tribe=<tribe>) for a clan.
  '%i:ci_fix.sase.@ x' parses fine and yields name='ci_fix.sase.@'.

IMPACT: any agent that follows these notes when authoring a prompt writes a directive that raises DirectiveError at launch. The notes are Tier 2 (xprompts.md) and Tier 1 always-loaded (glossary.md), so the wrong spelling is in front of every agent working on prompts or agent naming.

SCOPE: update the Directives table in sase/memory/xprompts.md to '%id:<n>' / alias '%i' and to drop the removed %tribe row in favor of the '%id(tribe=<tribe>)' / '#tribe:<tribe>' / '%clan(<clan>, tribe=<tribe>)' forms; update the 'Agent Tribe' glossary entry the same way; check the rest of both notes for other uses of the retired spellings. Memory-file edits require the user's explicit permission, which launching this task supplies; finish by running 'sase memory init' to regenerate AGENTS.md, the provider instruction shims, and the memory README, as the repo instructions require.

payload.entry: RELATED: sase-j1 — same genre (a SASE instruction surface left describing guidance that was since deleted or renamed), different surface and root cause: sase-j1 was the /sase_plan skill's size classification, this is the directive vocabulary in two memory notes.
